ing: or fresh white fish like snapper
st: If using smoked fish, soak it in hot water for 10 minutes, then flake it and remove the bones.
Heat [[0.25 cup]] palm oil in a large pot over medium heat. Cook the onion for 5 minutes.
Add the garlic, chili and tomatoes. Cook for 8 minutes until saucy.
Add the eggplant, okra, [[1 tsp]] salt and [[2 cup]] water. Cover and simmer for 20 minutes.
Lay the fish on top and simmer 10 minutes. Fresh fish should flake easily and be cooked to 145°F (63°C).
Add the spinach on top, cover and cook for 5 minutes until wilted.
Stir gently, taste for salt, and serve with rice, cooked cornmeal or boiled breadfruit.
Toss the fish with [[2 tbsp]] lime juice and [[0.5 tsp]] salt. Marinate for 15 minutes.
Heat [[3 tbsp]] palm oil in a wide pot over medium heat. Cook the onion for 5 minutes.
Add the garlic and chili for 1 minute.
Add the tomatoes and [[1 tsp]] salt. Cook 10 minutes until they melt into a thick sauce.
Pour in [[1 cup]] water and bring to a gentle simmer.
Add the fish, cover and simmer 8 minutes without stirring much, until it reaches 145°F (63°C) and flakes.
Sprinkle with [[2 tbsp]] parsley and serve with rice, cooked banana or breadfruit.
Soak the beans in water overnight (8 hours), then drain and rinse.
Heat [[2 tbsp]] palm oil in a large pot. Brown the pork for 8 minutes on all sides.
Add the onion and garlic and cook 5 minutes.
Add the beans, bay leaves, chili and [[8 cup]] water. Bring to a boil, skim the foam, and boil hard for 10 minutes.
Reduce to low, cover and simmer for 75 minutes until the beans are nearly tender.
Add the sausage, [[1.5 tsp]] salt and [[0.5 tsp]] pepper. Simmer uncovered for 30 minutes until the stew is thick and the pork is at least 145°F (63°C).
Remove the bay leaves and serve hot with rice or boiled cassava.

ing: snapper or mackerel, about 6 oz each
st: Mix the lemon juice, garlic, chili, [[1 tsp]] salt and [[1 tbsp]] oil. Rub it all over the fish and marinate for 30 minutes.
Peel the breadfruit, remove the core, and cut into thick slices.
Boil the slices in salted water with [[0.5 tsp]] salt for 20 minutes until tender, then drain.
Heat a grill or grill pan to medium-high and oil the grates lightly.
Grill the fish for 4 minutes per side until it flakes and reaches 145°F (63°C).
Brush the breadfruit with [[2 tbsp]] oil, sprinkle with [[0.5 tsp]] pepper and grill 3 minutes per side until charred in spots.
Serve the fish with the breadfruit and lemon wedges.
